threats.name: Zero-Day Beta: DNS Tunneling Exfiltration
threats.description: Stealthy chunked data exfiltration using DNS queries containing encoded payloads inside subdomain fields.
threats.attackTechnique: T1048.003 - Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol: DNS
indicators: Unusually long subdomain strings, repeating base64 query blocks

threats.name: SQL Injection Campaign (SQLi-X)
threats.description: Targeted injection vectors against SQL backends attempting database credential dumping and structure enumeration.

threats.name: TCP SYN Flood (SYN-Storm)
threats.description: Saturating gateway servers with TCP SYN requests from spoofed IPs, exhausting local system session queues.
threats.attackTechnique: T1498.001 - Network Denial of Service: Direct Flow Flooding
indicators: Extreme high packet density from distinct IP pools

threats.name: Zero-Day Alpha: Custom In-Memory Deserialization
threats.description: Novel, highly targeted Remote Code Execution (RCE) targetting an undocumented custom object deserialization handler.
indicators: Custom binary string triggers object instantiation bypass

threats.name: Reconnaissance Network Sweep (Scan-Pulse)
threats.description: Systematic mapping of open ports and OS fingerprints across internal VLANs to identify vulnerable services.
indicators: Sequential ports mapped over small millisecond intervals

rules.name: VLAN Sequential Scan Detect
rules.description: Triggers on sequential TCP socket pings across internal IP ranges.

rules.name: SQL Injection Signature Block
rules.description: Matches common patterns of database syntax injection in HTTP payloads.

rules.name: TCP SYN Packet Overflow Detect
rules.description: Triggers when a threshold of unacknowledged SYN flags is crossed.
